faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Kanpur Project Engineer recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to receive the application for the IIT Kanpur Project Engineer position is 30th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the institute before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Engineer post?
faq.answer: Candidates should possess an M.Tech or B.Tech degree with at least 3 years of experience in Computer Science Engineering, along with specific knowledge in Python, Machine Learning, AI, React Js, Typescript, Electron, and image processing.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Engineer position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Project Engineer post will receive a monthly salary ranging from Rs. 31,600 to Rs. 78,400.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the IIT Kanpur Project Engineer job?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted offline. Candidates need to download the application form from the official website, fill it correctly, and send it along with required documents via post to the address specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the post of Project Engineer in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The position of Project Engineer at IIT Kanpur is on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Project Engineer role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Engineer position will primarily involve an Interview.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of IIT Kanpur, which is https://www.iitk.ac.in.

faq.question: Q10. Does IIT Kanpur offer any age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: Please refer to the official notification for details regarding age relaxation for reserved categories, as this information is not explicitly provided in the summary.
